title: Cap. IV Arg. 8 Sol: faith precedes saving Peter, not the eternal decree — head of the error
pass_a_gloss: But now the internal act of God does not have those causes, nor does it require those antecedent conditions, which the very external effect of the aforesaid salvation has and prerequires. God does not save Peter unless with his faith preceding; but he decrees to save Peter in the free and eternal good pleasure of his will, not with this faith preceding as a condition for the constitution of the decree itself, but as a condition for the opportune and temporal effecting of the thing decreed. The head of the error therefore is, that the antecedent quality of faith, which ought to have been joined with the thing decreed, and set before the same in execution alone, is joined with the act of God decreeing, and set before his decree as an antecedent motive.
pass_b_english: God's internal act does not have the causes or require the antecedent conditions that the external effect of salvation has and prerequires. He does not save Peter unless Peter's faith precedes; yet he decrees to save Peter in the free eternal good pleasure of his will — not with that faith as a condition for constituting the decree, but as a condition for timely temporal effecting of what was decreed. The error's head: the antecedent quality of faith, which should be joined to the thing decreed and set before it only in execution, is joined to God's decreeing act and set before the decree as an antecedent motive.
source_text: Jam vero actus Dei internus non habet eas causas, nec requirit eas conditiones praecedaneas, quas habet et praerequirit ipsum externum salutis praedictae effectum. Non servat Petrum Deus nisi fide ejus praecedente; at decernit servare Petrum in gratuito et aeterno voluntatis suae beneplacito, non praecedente hac fide tanquam conditione ad decreti ipsius constitutionem, sed tanquam conditione ad rei decretae opportunam temporalemque effectionem. Caput ergo erroris est, quod qualitas fidei antecedanea, quae cum re decreta conjungi debuit, et eidem in sola exsecutione praeponi, cum actu Dei decernentis conjungatur, et decreto ejus tanquam antecedaneum motivum praeponatur.
